description: Source code for thermistor sensor handling, including temperature calculations, resistance conversions, and configuration setup for engine sensors in a vehicle control system.

classes.name: ThermistorMath
classes.description: Class providing thermistor temperature calculations and curve preparation.

methods.name: getKelvinTemperatureByResistance
methods.description: Calculates temperature in Kelvin from resistance using Steinhart-Hart equation.

methods.name: getResistance

methods.name: getTemperatureC
methods.description: Gets temperature in Celsius from thermistor configuration and ADC reading.

methods.name: prepareThermistorCurve
methods.description: Prepares Steinhart-Hart curve coefficients based on resistance-temperature points.
